question: Zero-new-corpus determination from the already hash-pinned text layer (research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-36306525220/raw/fulltext/2608.05784v1.txt, sha256 e286167a6ae51eebe1552f655876bae5a9c1728e16793b31e4adac4e9b154dbf): is a measured break-even reuse count f* reportable from this literature class at all, or is the persistence-economics anchor unavailable by construction? (a) State the COLD COUNTERFACTUAL arm explicitly, because the published model prices only the branch an agent takes and a break-even is meaningless without the alternative. (b) Derive f* and state the accounting convention assumed for the printed write term (charged once in total versus once per reuse). (c) Evaluate f* over the artifact's own published parameter values (R 60-343x modeled, h 0.090 in-sample and 0.077 out-of-sample, q reported degrading below 1, p the base success rate) and publish the regime table over which (h, q, Cwrite, Cverify) f* is finite, what f* is at the published point estimates, and at what h f* becomes operationally reachable. (d) State the divergence condition (carried state never pays for itself when E_cold <= E_warm plus amortized write cost). Exactly the mandate's Part 1 determination; no new corpus, browser, Docker or credential.
hypothesis: H1 (REPORTABLE): from the artifact's own published values there exists a finite, positive break-even reuse count f* = Cwrite / (E_cold - E_warm) on the artifact's published slice (h in {0.077, 0.086, 0.090, 0.131}; q below 1), and it is operationally reachable within the artifact's own observed reuse horizon (f* <= N_reach = 181 reuses of a recurring routine). H0 (UNAVAILABLE BY CONSTRUCTION): no such reportable value exists, because (i) the cold-warm saving is structurally non-positive (g <= 0, so the carried state never pays even with a free write), or (ii) it is finite but requires an input the artifact never publishes in units commensurable with Cmiss (Cwrite, Cverify, Cwrong, or p), so no f* with a stated denominator can be reported, or (iii) it is reachable only at h > 0.131 (a recurrence the artifact never measured).
falsifier: H1 is FALSIFIED if, under BOTH frozen readings of the preserved equation and BOTH frozen write conventions, either (F1) the dimensionless saving bracket g <= 0 at every cell of the published slice (structural divergence: E_cold <= E_warm even with a free write), or (F2) f* > N_reach = 181 at every cell where g > 0 using the artifact's published h and q (unreachable within the observed horizon), or (F3) f* is finite only if a required input (Cwrite, Cverify, Cwrong, or p) is supplied from outside the artifact, with no artifact-internal commensurable value, so no numeric f* with a denominator is reportable. H0 is FALSIFIED if there exists a published-slice cell, using only artifact-derived or explicitly swept values, where g > 0, f* <= 181, and h* <= 0.077 (the conservative out-of-sample recurrence), under at least one reading.

baselines.method: Exhaustive, case-insensitive pattern sweep of the frozen 69,607-character text layer for the paper's own publication of a break-even: terms {break-even, breakeven, break even, payback, f*, amortiz*} plus a manual read of the surrounding cost sections (lines 226-240, 898-975, 1155-1245).
baselines.frozen_expected_observation: The artifact publishes NO break-even reuse count f*, no payback term, and no 'f*' symbol. It publishes saving FRACTIONS and RATIOS instead: per-covered-step recovery 1 - 1/R (~99%, line 938), an all-fleet ceiling h(1 - 1/R_info) ~ 7.7% (lines 972-975), and a per-occurrence reduction 6.0x (line 956). Any 'reportable f*' must therefore be DERIVED by this experiment, not read off; and the artifact's own numbers are not a published f*.
baselines.why_this_is_the_baseline: It bounds the claim to 'derivable from the artifact', not 'published by the artifact', and it establishes that the artifact's headline economics are saving rates, not break-even counts.

baselines.type: strong baseline / best artifact-internal candidate for an f* proxy
baselines.method: Attempt to invert the artifact's strongest published economics quantity, the all-fleet ceiling h(1 - 1/R_info) ~ 7.7% (lines 972-975, 1015), into a break-even reuse count without this experiment's cold arm.
baselines.frozen_expected_observation: The inversion fails: h(1 - 1/R_info) is a fraction of re-derivation cost recovered by carried state, not a write-repayment count. It contains no Cwrite term and no cold arm, so it cannot yield f* on its own. This baseline prevents the experiment from mislabeling a saving rate as a break-even.
baselines.why_this_is_the_baseline: It is the most generous artifact-internal candidate; if even it cannot yield f*, no weaker artifact quantity can.

positive_control.type: known-answer positive control for the f* engine
positive_control.method: Instantiate the closed form f* = Cwrite / (E_cold - E_warm) on a hand-computed, fully specified parameter cell with g > 0 and a finite f* (e.g. h=0.5, q=1.0, p=1.0, Chit=0, Cverify=0, Cwrong=0, Cwrite=1 in Cmiss units => E_cold=1, E_warm=0.5, f*=2).
positive_control.frozen_expected_observation: The engine returns f* = 2.0 within 1e-9 relative error, finite and positive.
positive_control.role: Certifies the arithmetic branch that can return a finite f* actually fires, so a later NOT_FINITE is attributable to the data, not to a broken engine.

null_control.method: Instantiate the SAME engine on a fully specified cell known to be divergent: g <= 0 (e.g. h=0.5, q=0.1, p=1.0, Chit=0, Cverify=0.5, Cwrong=10 => g = 0.1*(1 - 0 - 0.5) - 0.9*10 < 0), and additionally evaluate on a cell where f* > N_reach.
null_control.frozen_expected_observation: The engine returns NOT_FINITE / divergent (no positive finite f*) for g <= 0, and returns UNREACHABLE for 181 < f* < inf, never a spurious positive finite f*.
null_control.pass_condition: g <= 0 => engine reports divergent; 181 < f* < inf => engine reports unreachable.
null_control.role: Satisfies the discriminating-control prior: certifies the instrument can return the negative branch, so a NOT_FINITE / UNREACHABLE on the published slice is interpretable as a property of the artifact rather than of the tool.

additional_controls.method: Derive the text layer's fraction-parsing rule from the unambiguous stacked equations (2) Cagent(k)=k(wh/750 + 350 + 180) and (3) R = Cagent(k)/Creplay(k), Creplay(k)=|tiktoken(.)|, whose structural forms are independently known, then apply the derived rule to Eq. (1) and record which reading it selects.
additional_controls.frozen_expected_observation: The OCR linearizes stacked fractions numerator-newline-denominator (confirmed by 'wh/750' and 'Cagent(k)' over 'Creplay(k)'). Applied to Eq. (1), the rule selects the literal division reading: (1-hq)Cmiss/p, hq(Chit+Cverify), h(1-q)Cwrong, Cwrite/N.
additional_controls.fail_action: If the rule cannot be established, the primary reading is not identifiable and the determination is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

additional_controls.method: Re-extract the frozen published anchors by independent search and compare to frozen expected values.
additional_controls.frozen_expected_observation: h in {0.077, 0.086, 0.090, 0.131}; R_inject=60x (IQR 59-62), R_info=343x; q bounded below 1 with entity typing ~82%; compile cost <=0.5ms, 0 tokens; median guard coverage 0.415; routine instances 5,508 across 614 recurring routines; max occurrences 181; 3-arm modeled dollars $125.81 / $20.96 / $74.46.
additional_controls.fail_action: Any mismatch => MEASUREMENT_INVALID for the affected anchor; the anchor is then recorded as unavailable, not as zero.

additional_controls.method: Evaluate the SAME parameter cell under both write conventions: AMORTIZE-ONCE (write total Cwrite charged once; per-task write = Cwrite/N) and PER-REUSE (write Cwrite charged on every reuse; total grows as Cwrite*N).
additional_controls.frozen_expected_observation: PER-REUSE collapses the break-even to a degenerate condition independent of N (f*=1 if the per-task inequality holds, else no f*), differing from AMORTIZE-ONCE by orders of magnitude. The control fires iff the two conventions give materially different f* on the same cell.
additional_controls.fail_action: If they do not differ, the convention axis is misimplemented => MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

measurement_validity: Evidence is a single hash-pinned artifact: path and sha256 are asserted in every derived artifact; the file is 70,219 bytes / 69,607 characters / 1,447 lines. A hash or size mismatch invalidates all derived measurements.
Every quoted formula, parameter and limitation is quoted verbatim with line numbers from the frozen text layer; no quantity is imported from any other paper, dataset or run.

The preserved equation is OCR-linearized. The multiply-vs-divide ambiguity (Cmiss/p vs Cmiss*p; Cwrite/N vs Cwrite*N) is NOT silently resolved: both readings are frozen and every reported class is reported per reading. PC-READING establishes the text-literal reading as primary; the mandate's literal form is carried as an explicit secondary reading.

The write-accounting convention is NOT silently resolved: AMORTIZE-ONCE (primary, consistent with the mandate's f* formula) and PER-REUSE (secondary) are both frozen, and NC-CONVENTION certifies they differ.

Because f* = Cwrite/(h*g) is dimensionless when all C-terms are normalized by Cmiss, a numeric f* is reportable only if the artifact provides the ratio w=Cwrite/Cmiss in commensurable units. The artifact prints compile cost as '<=0.5ms, 0 tokens' (w_model ~ 0) but prints capture/storage cost only in wall-clock and GB (9.5GB, ~0.19GB/active day, OCR on 96% of frames), never in dollars-per-task commensurable with Cmiss. Whether this counts as an artifact-internal w is a frozen adjudication axis, not an assumption.

Modeled vs measured is preserved exactly as the artifact labels it: R's numerator and the three-arm dollars are 'modeled, not billed' (lines 1160-1168); the denominators (guarded plan, minimal script, guard coverage 0.415) are measured. No modeled quantity is reported as measured.

Scope is the artifact, not the literature class: this is a determination of whether an f* is derivable from THIS hash-pinned text layer, not a prevalence claim about all persistent-state economics literature. Any generalization is explicitly out of scope.

Non-adoption bar (inherited, preserved): no quantity from arXiv:2608.05784v1 may enter a SPIDER cost model, break-even derivation, product plan or investor-facing material. This experiment treats the artifact's quantities as the OBJECT of a reportability analysis, never as a SPIDER comparator or cost input. See scope_and_non_adoption.
f* is reported as a real number with the operational integer horizon ceil(f*) noted separately; reachability is f* <= N_reach, not f* < N_reach.
Every reported class carries the reading, convention, N_reach and whether each C-term was artifact-derived or swept. An unresolvable mandatory input is reported as absent, never as zero.

Independent recomputation: the regime table is produced by two implementations (a direct per-cell evaluator and an independent closed-form using the dimensionless g), which must agree at all sampled cells.

p ('base success rate') is not published numerically by the artifact; it is a swept axis, labeled unpublished. If no reported class survives over the whole p sweep, that non-robustness is stated explicitly.

decision_rule.precedence: Apply gates in order; the first gate that fires sets the status.
decision_rule.gate_0_measurement_invalid: MEASUREMENT_INVALID (status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=MEASUREMENT_INVALID) if ANY of: evidence sha256 != e286167a6ae51eebe1552f655876bae5a9c1728e16793b31e4adac4e9b154dbf or size != 70,219 bytes; a required formula/parameter span cannot be located verbatim; PC-READING fails; PC-EXTRACT fails on a load-bearing anchor; PC-ALGEBRA does not reproduce the hand-computed f*; NC-DIVERGENT does not fire the negative branch; NC-CONVENTION does not distinguish the conventions; or the two table implementations disagree. Measurement failure is not a scientific negative.
decision_rule.gate_1_reportability_class_per_reading: For each frozen reading R in {VAR-LIT (primary: Cmiss/p, Cwrite/N), VAR-MAN (secondary: Cmiss*p, Cwrite*N)} and each convention in {AMORTIZE-ONCE (primary), PER-REUSE (secondary)}, classify the published slice using only artifact-derived values plus the frozen sweeps: DIVERGENT if g <= 0 at every published-slice cell (structural divergence); FINITE_NOT_EVALUABLE if g > 0 somewhere but no artifact-internal commensurable w anchors a numeric f*, so only the locus h*(w)=w/(N_reach*g) can be reported; UNREACHABLE if g > 0 and f* > N_reach at every published-slice cell; REACHABLE if there exists a published-slice cell with g > 0 and f* <= N_reach.
decision_rule.gate_2_verdict: Derive the verdict per (reading, convention) from gate_1, then aggregate: SUPPORTS (claim C-PRODUCT-ECON: a measured break-even f* is reportable from this artifact) iff REACHABLE under every non-secondary reading and the REACHABLE region includes h <= 0.077; FALSIFIES (the persistence-economics anchor is unavailable by construction from this artifact) iff every (reading, convention) classifies DIVERGENT, FINITE_NOT_EVALUABLE or UNREACHABLE; MIXED if the classes disagree across readings/conventions or if REACHABLE holds only at h > 0.077 (i.e. only at the URL-granularity 0.131 or otherwise above the recurrence the artifact says the cost accounting should carry).
decision_rule.gate_3_h_star_report: Always report the critical recurrence h*(w) = w/(N_reach*g) for each convention/reading and the smallest published h at which f* <= N_reach; state whether that h is <= 0.077 (conservative out-of-sample), <= 0.131 (max published), or beyond 0.131 (never measured, hence unavailable by construction).
decision_rule.gate_4_divergence_report: Always report, in the artifact's own terms, the divergence condition: E_cold <= E_warm plus the amortized write cost. Structural form: E_cold - E_warm = h*g <= 0. Operational form under AMORTIZE-ONCE: E_cold <= E_warm + Cwrite/N. State both explicitly even when neither fires.

frozen_numerics.N_reach_basis: max observed occurrences of a recurring action routine (line 919, 'Median steps k / max occ. 5 / 181'); 5,508 instances across 614 recurring routines gives a mean of ~9.
frozen_numerics.h_star_rule: reachable iff h_star(w) <= max published h (0.131); claim-supporting iff also h_star(w) <= 0.077.

derivations.cold_counterfactual: With no carried state, the hit branch is empty (h=0) and the one-time write is absent, so E_cold = Cmiss/p under VAR-LIT (the cost of one miss re-derivation) and E_cold = Cmiss*p under VAR-MAN. The artifact's Eq. (1) prices only the WARM branch an agent actually takes; E_cold must be supplied by this experiment as the explicit counterfactual, which is the whole point of the mandate's clause (a).
derivations.delta: delta = E_cold - E_warm = h*g, where g = q*(E_cold_unit - Chit - Cverify) - (1-q)*Cwrong and E_cold_unit is Cmiss/p (VAR-LIT) or Cmiss*p (VAR-MAN). g is independent of h.
derivations.break_even: AMORTIZE-ONCE: total warm cost over N tasks = N*E_warm + Cwrite; total cold = N*E_cold; break-even at N > Cwrite/(E_cold - E_warm) = Cwrite/(h*g) = f*. PER-REUSE: total warm = N*(E_warm + Cwrite); break-even collapses to a single-task inequality, E_cold > E_warm + Cwrite, giving f*=1 if true else no f*.
derivations.dimensionless_form: Normalize every C-term by Cmiss: r=Chit/Cmiss=1/R (R in {60,343}, artifact-modeled), b=Cverify/Cmiss, c=Cwrong/Cmiss, w=Cwrite/Cmiss. Then f* = w/(h*g) with g = q*(1/p - r - b) - (1-q)*c  [VAR-LIT] or g = q*(p - r - b) - (1-q)*c  [VAR-MAN]. f* depends only on ratios, not on absolute dollars.
derivations.critical_h: The recurrence at which f* equals the observed reuse horizon is h*(w) = w/(N_reach*g); f* is reachable iff h*(w) <= published h.
derivations.divergence_condition: Structural: E_cold - E_warm = h*g <= 0, i.e. g <= 0, meaning carried state does not pay even if the write is free. Operational: E_cold <= E_warm + amortized write per task (Cwrite/N under AMORTIZE-ONCE), i.e. f* > N.

VAR-LIT.basis: OCR literal: stacked numerator over denominator, corroborated by Eq. (2) 'wh/750' and Eq. (3) 'Cagent(k)' over 'Creplay(k)'.

VAR-MAN.basis: The mandate's literal formula as written; carried as an explicit secondary reading, not silently discarded.

AMORTIZE-ONCE.meaning: Cwrite charged once in total; per-task amortized write = Cwrite/N. Consistent with f*=Cwrite/(E_cold-E_warm).

PER-REUSE.meaning: Cwrite charged on every reuse; total write = Cwrite*N; break-even degenerates.

sweeps.w_note: 0 corresponds to the artifact's compile-only '0 tokens' reading; 1/60 and 1/343 are R-normalized placeholders; capture-inclusive w is unpublished.

regime_table.published_point_estimates_report: f* at (h=0.077, q=0.82) and (h=0.090, q=0.82) for each reading/convention across the w and b sweeps, plus the critical h at which the artifact's published h would become reachable.

reportability_classes.REACHABLE: finite positive f* with artifact-derived or explicitly-swept inputs, f* <= N_reach.
reportability_classes.UNREACHABLE: g > 0 but f* > N_reach at every published-slice cell.
reportability_classes.FINITE_NOT_EVALUABLE: g > 0 but no artifact-internal commensurable Cwrite/Cmiss exists, so no numeric f* with a denominator is reportable (only the h*(w) locus is).
reportability_classes.DIVERGENT: g <= 0 across the published slice: carried state does not pay even with a free write.

output_contract.evidence_preservation: All verbatim spans, the evidence path and sha256, and the full regime table are written to a derived artifact under this experiment directory; raw evidence is never modified.
output_contract.mapping_to_claim: A REACHABLE verdict is EXPERIMENTAL evidence that a measured f* is reportable from this artifact class and licenses a follow-up census mandate. A DIVERGENT/UNREACHABLE/FINITE_NOT_EVALUABLE verdict supports C-PRODUCT-ECON only as a scope finding (the external anchor is unavailable by construction), and Product must then measure its own marginal recurrence h(N) and first-party Cwrite.
output_contract.no_self_promotion: This experiment may not promote C-PRODUCT-ECON; it produces evidence for the lane DIRECTOR.

scope_and_non_adoption.scope: Determination of reportability/derivability of f* from the single hash-pinned artifact; not a prevalence claim over all persistent-state economics literature, and not a measurement of SPIDER's own recurrence.
scope_and_non_adoption.preserved_do_not_assume: Inherited from the parent verdict/handoff: the corpus is one professional over a bounded active-day window; R_inject 60x and R_info 343x numerators and the three-arm dollar table are modeled, not billed; no quantity from arXiv:2608.05784v1 may enter a SPIDER cost model, break-even derivation, product plan or investor-facing material. This experiment analyzes the artifact as an object and does not adopt its numbers.
scope_and_non_adoption.known_conflict_recorded: The parent verdict's product_action bars introducing arXiv:2608.05784v1 quantities into a break-even derivation; the Director mandate directs deriving f* from those quantities. Resolution frozen here: the experiment studies reportability of f* FROM the artifact (object of study) without adopting any artifact quantity into SPIDER's economics; the positive consequence is a license to fund an external census, not adoption of the artifact's numbers.

product_consequence_positive: If the determination is REACHABLE (finite f* at published h and f* <= N_reach), then a measured break-even reuse count IS reportable from this literature class: the persistence-economics anchor is not structurally missing, one properly designed external census is worth funding (the natural next Intel mandate), and Product may treat h(N) as an estimate-able external quantity rather than a first-party-only unknown. C-PRODUCT-ECON remains HYPOTHESIS pending that census; this experiment does not promote it.
product_consequence_negative: If the determination is DIVERGENT, UNREACHABLE or FINITE_NOT_EVALUABLE, then the persistence-economics anchor is unavailable BY CONSTRUCTION from this artifact class: a three-cycle open external search for a published f* is retired permanently, no census is funded, and Product must measure its own marginal recurrence h(N) and first-party Cwrite on the shipped path before any break-even claim is admissible. C-PRODUCT-ECON is then supported only as a scope/negative finding.

estimated_cost.substrate: local read of one 70,219-byte hash-pinned text file plus deterministic arithmetic
estimated_cost.note: Zero-new-corpus analytic determination exactly as bounded by the Director mandate.

expected_information_gain: High. This is a cheap, decidable determination whose either outcome changes a live product/portfolio decision: it either licenses one properly designed external census or permanently retires the external f* search and redirects Product to measure first-party recurrence. It also establishes a reusable algebra (cold arm, reading and convention axes, divergence condition, critical-h locus) that the census design and Product's economics benchmark can reuse with stable identities. It is orthogonal to the two failed searches and closes the Part B proposal left unexecuted by EXP-INTEL-36306525220.
